notes: GenApp's Db2 'inquire policy' (LGIPDB01, LINKed by LGIPOL01 with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA; the COMMAREA is described by the record the caller passes, LGIPOL01's DFHCOMMAREA (COPY LGCMAREA), since LGIPDB01 includes the same copybook with EXEC SQL INCLUDE: the generated DTO is the caller's): the request id, upper-cased, picks the inquiry -- 01IEND / 01IHOU / 01IMOT / 01ICOM a SELECT INTO on POLICY joined with ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR / COMMERCIAL by customer and policy number; 02ICOM a commercial SELECT by policy number alone (returning the customer number); 03ICOM the scroll cursor Cust_Cursor over a customer's commercial policies; 05ICOM the cursor Zip_Cursor over COMMERCIAL rows with CA-B-POSTCODE; anything else '99'. A row found is moved into CA-POLICY-COMMON and the type's area, marked 'FINAL'; +100 gives '01'. Tables (unqualified: the bind's QUALIFIER, GENASA1) are GenApp's own (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl: DDL and INSERTs, <DB2DBID> = GENASA1) and compared after every scenario. Not reachable here: EIBCALEN 0 (ABEND LGCA, l.251-255) and a COMMAREA too short for the policy ('98', l.390-392, 487-489, 581-583, 689-691, 793-795) -- the harness passes the whole 32500-byte COMMAREA; any negative SQLCODE ('90', l.426-428 and its copies; OPEN '89' l.843-847, 926-930; CLOSE '88' l.855-859, 938-942) -- no seeded data causes one and Db2 errors are not injectable (M2), and each path LINKs to LGSTSQ, which the harness does not run; a non-NULL PADDINGDATA (l.384-385, 411-412) and a NULL BROKERID / PAYMENT (the false side of l.397, 400, 494, 497, 588, 591) -- GenApp's endowment INSERTs omit PADDINGDATA and every policy has brokerId 0 and payment 0; more than one row from either cursor and the 20-row cap (l.907-908) -- each seeded customer and zipcode has at most one commercial policy.
